## File: facebookresearch_map-anything/mapanything/models/external/dinov2/hub/backbones.py

Prompts

```
['build a DINOv2 ViT-L/14 vision transformer model pretrained on the LVD-142M dataset', 'build a DINOv2 ViT-g/14 vision transformer model with swiglufused FFN layer pretrained on LVD-142M', 'build a DINOv2 ViT-L/14 model with 4 register tokens and antialias interpolation enabled', 'build a DINOv2 ViT-S/14 small vision transformer model pretrained on the LVD-142M dataset', 'build a custom DINOv2 model with specified architecture, image size, patch size, and pretrained weights', 'create a function that generates a DINOv2 model name from arch name, patch size, and register token count', 'build a PyTorch CenterPadding module that pads tensor dimensions to a specified multiple', 'create a CenterPadding instance to pad a PyTorch tensor so each spatial dimension is divisible by a given multiple', 'build a helper that calculates left and right padding values to make a dimension size divisible by a multiple', 'review the CenterPadding forward method to understand how it computes and applies symmetric padding across tensor dimensions']
```

```
{'build_dinov2_vitl14': 'build a DINOv2 ViT-L/14 vision transformer model pretrained on the LVD-142M dataset', 'build_dinov2_vitg14': 'build a DINOv2 ViT-g/14 vision transformer model with swiglufused FFN layer pretrained on LVD-142M', 'build_dinov2_vitl14_reg': 'build a DINOv2 ViT-L/14 model with 4 register tokens and antialias interpolation enabled', 'build_dinov2_vits14': 'build a DINOv2 ViT-S/14 small vision transformer model pretrained on the LVD-142M dataset', 'build_dinov2_custom': 'build a custom DINOv2 model with specified architecture, image size, patch size, and pretrained weights'}
```

facebookresearch_map-anything/mapanythin.build_dinov2_vitl14: build a DINOv2 ViT-L/14 vision transformer model pretrained on the LVD-142M dataset
facebookresearch_map-anything/mapanythin.build_dinov2_vitg14: build a DINOv2 ViT-g/14 vision transformer model with swiglufused FFN layer pretrained on LVD-142M

facebookresearch_map-anything/mapanythin.make_dinov2_model_name: create a function that generates a DINOv2 model name from arch name, patch size, and register token count
facebookresearch_map-anything/mapanythin.create_center_padding_module: build a PyTorch CenterPadding module that pads tensor dimensions to a specified multiple
facebookresearch_map-anything/mapanythin.pad_tensor_to_multiple: create a CenterPadding instance to pad a PyTorch tensor so each spatial dimension is divisible by a given multiple
facebookresearch_map-anything/mapanythin.compute_padding_for_dimension: build a helper that calculates left and right padding values to make a dimension size divisible by a multiple
facebookresearch_map-anything/mapanythin.review_center_padding_forward: review the CenterPadding forward method to understand how it computes and applies symmetric padding across tensor dimensions
